question: Which deities and lords appear in the cities and waters?
premises: In many cities Ganga, Shri, and Sarasvati appear.
God-lords range from Lakula to Amarasha.
inference: The verse enumerates deities and lords across cities and waters.
plain_english: In many cities Ganga, Shri, and Sarasvati appear; god-lords range from Lakula to Amarasha, with eight in the waters.
